staff.title: Team access
staff.elevate: Verify security key for team access
staff.confirm: I confirm this exact target and change
staff.registerHint: A fresh password and authenticator check permits key registration only. It does not grant team access.
staff.recovery: Recovery uses a replacement account, one verified key (which may be new) and offline material. Additional keys are optional. The old account stays on security hold; its private debates stay with it. Password or authenticator codes cannot replace the key proofs.
staff.unavailable: Team tools are temporarily unavailable. Try again later.
staff.failed: The action could not be completed. Refresh and review the details before trying again.
staff.denied: Team access is locked. Verify your security key again.
staff.locked: Team tools are locked. The operator can unlock them for one hour at a time.
staff.signIn: Sign in to check account readiness.
staff.webauthn: Security key verification unavailable or cancelled. Try again with your verified key.
staff.stale: Revision changed. Current data has been refreshed; review and confirm a new operation.
staff.possessionHint: Use the prepared command and its privately supplied nonce and the selected verified public credential ID. A second ID is needed only if that command selected two keys. This records possession receipts only.
staff.keyTwo: Second selected public credential ID (only for a two-key command)
staff.possessed: Possession receipts recorded. The independent operator must complete the prepared command.
staff.reopenSignedIn: Sign in, then reopen the original invitation link from your email. The invitation is not saved in this browser.
staff.acceptHint: Acceptance checks the current invitation revision with the server and requires your verified security key. It creates no staff session.
staff.acceptFailed: Invitation has not been accepted. It may be pending, disabled, expired or unavailable. Reopen the original link after checking readiness.
staff.accepted: Invitation accepted. Verify your security key separately on the team page to obtain team access.
staff.receiptsHint: Pass these recorded receipt IDs to the independent operator before their expiry. A partial result does not complete the prepared command.
staff.intro: Manage team access and security activity with your verified security key.
staff.unlockHint: Verify your security key to see the access available to you.
staff.notReady: Check your account, verified email and authenticator before continuing.
staff.addKeyHint: Register an additional key using your verified team access.
staff.membersHint: Review members and the permissions assigned to them.
staff.targetHint: Use the exact account ID shared by the recipient from their account details.
staff.help.invite: Choose permissions for this account. Your security key confirms the invitation.
staff.help.grant: Choose the permissions this member should keep. Your security key confirms the change.
staff.help.disable: Remove this member’s team access for offboarding. Your security key confirms the change.
staff.help.compromise: Disable team access after a suspected compromise. Review the selected member before confirming with your security key.
staff.advancedHint: Use these options when setting up a security key or completing a prepared recovery.
